description: This file defines a client class for managing model groups via API calls to a server. It includes methods to retrieve information about model groups, handle headers for authorization, and manage request execution.

classes.name: ModelGroupsManagementClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with model group management API, capable of retrieving information about model groups and managing request headers.

methods.description: Prepares request headers, including authorization token if API key is provided.

methods.name: Union[List[Dict[str,Any]],requests.Request] info(self, return_request: bool = False)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about all model groups from the server; can return either raw request object or the parsed response data.
